roleTitle: Predictive Sales AI Customer Success Consultant

job.rawJd: About the job. Job Title: Customer Success Consultant. Location: Chicago, IL - Remote/Hybrid. About Us: Predictive Sales AI is at the forefront of transforming the home services industry with AI-driven software. We empower businesses to make smarter decisions, increase efficiency, and unlock new growth opportunities. As part of our growth, we are seeking an experienced accountant who thrives in a fast-paced, innovative environment. Are you passionate about supporting business growth through innovative products that are reshaping the industry? At Predictive Sales AI, we're revolutionizing the home services market with cutting-edge AI-driven software, and we're looking for a talented Customer Success Consultant to join our dynamic team. If you're passionate about advancing financial practices while supporting tech-focused clients, we want to hear from you. Job Overview: We don't just deliver software - we are at the forefront of a customer experience revolution, providing cutting-edge solutions and comprehensive support to transform our clients into thriving, long-term partners. As a Customer Success Consultant, you will guide a diverse portfolio of PSAI clients through onboarding, adoption, and ongoing growth, combining relationship-management expertise with training to create measurable value. Key Responsibilities: Own the client lifecycle from kickoff through renewal; design and execute success plans aligned to business goals; ensure long-term retention and growth; guide new clients through implementation of AI-driven software; configure accounts to client needs; set expectations for early wins and adoption; build trust-based relationships with stakeholders and decision-makers; uncover expansion opportunities and build advocacy; conduct onboarding and ongoing training; identify opportunities for deeper platform usage; assess KPIs, usage data, and account health scores; implement strategies to improve outcomes and reduce churn risk; use a proactive consultative approach; and collaborate with onboarding, support, product, and sales teams to improve adoption and renewal pathways. Desired Traits: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities; organized and detail-oriented; excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communication; ownership and follow-through; customer-service focus; professional demeanor and composure. Required Skills and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, or a related field. Two or more years of professional Customer Success, Account Management, or Client Services experience with hands-on knowledge of SaaS or software products. Experience managing B2B or B2C clients in a consultative or account-management capacity. Proven ability to guide new clients through software onboarding and drive early product adoption. Project-management ability across multiple accounts and projects. Experience with retention and growth. Understanding of SaaS platforms and their impact on client workflows and outcomes. Some CRM or customer-success-platform experience. Proficiency with analytics and reporting tools to develop performance insights and actionable recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication for client interactions, presentations, and reporting. Why Join Us: Innovative environment, professional growth, comprehensive benefits, flexible work arrangements, performance-based bonuses, and a collaborative culture.

fitGate.recommendation: Proceed as adjacent. Lead with direct account ownership, AI-software fluency, consultative communication, enterprise adoption, performance analysis, and cross-functional delivery. Do not imply formal renewal, retention, churn, CRM, health-score, or expansion ownership.
